truth_boundary: This guard proves selected repository evidence declarations agree at one commit, including the machine matrix, primary root-gate report, public README count, bounded Trust Model claims, and the explicit held state that same-repository JavaScript + Go portability evidence is not independently authored external or third-party interoperability. The fixed comparator portability JavaScript/Go checks are declared supplemental evidence because they reproduce already-bounded comparator relationships and selected refusal states rather than introducing a new trust-protocol success state; they therefore do not inflate the 130-case protocol matrix. The guard does not prove fixture completeness, documentation completeness, semantic correctness beyond exercised cases, external interoperability, broad conformance, global freshness, synchronization, fork resolution, hostile-environment security, or AXM-wide CANON status.
